The original 43.5% / 22 of 49 activities remains unchanged.

Review-driven repairs cover a truncated traceback false positive, malformed caret ranges, a multi-token macro argument that splits token-paste chains and can synthesize `__has_include`, and a trailing no-final-newline patch marker. Failed and repaired evidence is retained.

Source and repair windows were closed before publication. Recorded original policy debit is 94.550533479/2400 seconds; unmetered preparation, review and publication costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.
